import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def pump_failure(f):
    "Pump in fault status (2) is failed; running (1) is not failed; stopped (0) is unknown."
    result = (f.pump_status == 2)
    result[f.pump_status == 0] = np.nan
    return result


def pipeline_leak(f):
    "Pipeline receive flow significantly lower than pump flow while pump runs, indicating leak."
    running = f.pump_status == 1
    signal = (f.pump_flow_bpd - f.pipeline_receive_flow_bpd).where(running)
    median_signal = signal.rolling(6, min_periods=6).median()
    result = (median_signal > f.max_flow_bpd * 0.05).where(running)
    return result


def pump_degradation(f):
    "Pump flow gradually declines while running, indicating wear."
    running = f.pump_status == 1
    baseline = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    current = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(6, min_periods=6).median()
    comparison = (current < baseline - f.max_flow_bpd * 0.1)
    result = comparison.where(running)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def pump_failure(f):
    "Pump is in fault status (2); returns NaN when the pump is stopped."
    result = (f.pump_status == 2).astype("boolean")
    result[f.pump_status == 0] = pd.NA
    return result


def pipeline_leak(f):
    "Pipeline receive flow significantly lower than pump flow while the pump runs."
    running = f.pump_status == 1
    diff = (f.pump_flow_bpd - f.pipeline_receive_flow_bpd).where(running)
    # Flag when the drop is at least 7 % of the facility’s max flow
    threshold = f.max_flow_bpd * 0.07
    candidate = diff > threshold
    # Require the condition to last at least three consecutive 5‑min steps (15 min)
    leak = candidate.rolling(3, min_periods=3).max()
    # No signal when the pump is not running
    leak = leak.where(running)
    return leak.astype("boolean")


def pump_degradation(f):
    "Pump flow gradually declines while running, indicating wear."
    running = f.pump_status == 1
    # 6‑step (30 min) rolling median of current flow
    current = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(6, min_periods=6).median()
    # 48‑step (4 hr) rolling median as the recent baseline
    baseline = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    # Degrade when current flow is at least 7 % below baseline
    degrade = current < baseline - f.max_flow_bpd * 0.07
    # Require the condition to persist for at least two consecutive windows (~1 h)
    degrade = degrade.rolling(2, min_periods=2).max()
    # No signal when the pump is stopped
    degrade = degrade.where(running)
    return degrade.astype("boolean")

    threshold = f.max_flow_bpd * 0.05

    leak = candidate.rolling(3, min_periods=3).max()

def pump_degradation(f):

    baseline = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    # 6‑step (30 min) rolling median of current flow
    current = f.pump_flow_bpd.rolling(6, min_periods=6).median()
    # Degrade when current flow is at least 4 % below the recent baseline
    degrade = current < baseline - f.max_flow_bpd * 0.04
    # Require persistence of at least 12 steps (1 h) to suppress the short ~1 h false‑alarm events
    degrade = degrade.rolling(12, min_periods=12).max()
    degrade = degrade.where(running)
    return degrade.astype("boolean")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def pump_failure(f):
    "Alarm if pump_status==2 for 3 consecutive steps, or pump_flow==0 for 3 steps with tank level rising (inflow>0). NaN when pump is off."
    result = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=f.index, dtype="boolean")
    eval_mask = f.pump_status != 0
    cond_a = (f.pump_status == 2).rolling(3, min_periods=3).all()
    cond_b_flow = (f.pump_flow_bpd == 0).rolling(3, min_periods=3).all()
    cond_b_tank = (f.tank_level_pct.diff() > 0).rolling(3, min_periods=3).all()
    cond_b = cond_b_flow & cond_b_tank
    combined = cond_a | cond_b
    result[eval_mask & combined] = True
    result[eval_mask & ~combined] = False
    return result


def pipeline_leak(f):
    "Alarm if pipeline pressure well below disposal setpoint and flow imbalance indicates leak, while pump runs. NaN when pump is off."
    result = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=f.index, dtype="boolean")
    mask = f.pump_status == 1
    cond_pressure = f.pipeline_pressure_psi < f.disposal_psi * 0.90
    cond_flow = (f.pump_flow_bpd - f.pipeline_receive_flow_bpd) > f.max_flow_bpd * 0.05
    cond = cond_pressure & cond_flow
    alarm = cond.rolling(3, min_periods=3).all()
    result[mask & alarm] = True
    result[mask & ~alarm] = False
    return result


def pump_degradation(f):
    "Alarm if pump flow declines 2.5% below 8h baseline for 1h persistence. NaN when pump is not running."
    result = pd.Series(pd.NA, index=f.index, dtype="boolean")
    mask = f.pump_status == 1
    ratio = f.pump_flow_bpd / f.max_flow_bpd
    rolling_48 = ratio.rolling(48, min_periods=48).median()
    baseline = ratio.rolling(96, min_periods=96).median()
    degrade_signal = rolling_48 < baseline - 0.025
    alarm = degrade_signal.rolling(12, min_periods=12).all()
    result[mask & alarm] = True
    result[mask & ~alarm] = False
    return result
